name: Fafda-Jalebi
instructions: 1. For Fafda, knead besan with oil, ajwain, hing, salt, and turmeric into a stiff dough; roll into thin strips and deep fry until crispy.
2. For Jalebi, prepare a fermented batter of maida and curd, let it sit for a few hours, then pipe it in spirals into hot oil.
3. Prepare a sugar syrup infused with saffron and cardamom.
4. Dip the fried Jalebis into the warm syrup until they soak it up.
5. Serve the crispy, salty Fafda alongside the sweet, juicy Jalebi.
description: Fafda-Jalebi is the quintessential Gujarati breakfast, often enjoyed on Dussehra. The pairing creates a perfect balance of salty, crunchy textures from the Fafda and sweet, floral syrup from the Jalebi, representing a beloved culinary tradition.
